description: This file contains utility classes and functions for managing and interfacing with base language models (LLMs) in the 'litellm' project. It defines abstract base classes for token counting and model information, includes functions for processing tool responses, schema handling, and message translation.

classes.name: BaseTokenCounter
classes.description: Abstract base class for counting tokens in messages for LLMs.

classes.name: BaseLLMModelInfo
classes.description: Abstract base class for obtaining information about supported LLM models and provider details.

methods.description: Abstract method to asynchronously count tokens in given messages or contents for a specific model.

methods.name: bool should_use_token_counting_api( self, custom_llm_provider: Optional[str] = None, )
methods.description: Determine if the token counting API should be used for a given provider.

methods.description: Retrieve provider-specific information for a given model.

methods.name: List[str] get_models( self, api_key: Optional[str] = None, api_base: Optional[str] = None )
methods.description: Retrieve list of supported models from the provider.

methods.name: Optional[str] get_api_key(api_key: Optional[str] = None)
methods.description: Abstract static method for obtaining the API key.

methods.name: Optional[str] get_api_base( api_base: Optional[str] = None, )
methods.description: Abstract static method for obtaining the API base URL.

methods.description: Abstract method for validating environment and parameters for a model request.

methods.name: Optional[str] get_base_model(model: str)

methods.description: Converts response format definitions (dict or pydantic model) to a schema suitable for API requests.
